T-004.Title: /ext/apply answers by fact: pre-emit op validation, the mt::ext::text_op_ack channel with a bounded per-batch timeout, and bounded request-id idempotency

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: src-tauri/src/m045_ext/live_server.rs ExtApplyRequest gains the optional serde field request_id: Option<String> (absent deserializes None; legacy senders keep working); handle_ext_apply's order becomes: capability gate (unchanged) → dedup short-circuit (new, after authentication, before the fence) → binding fence 400/409 (unchanged, still before any event) → op validation → registration → emit → await acks → answer.

Pre-emit validation: the op set is checked before any emission — any op_type outside replace_selection/insert_at_cursor/undo refuses the whole batch 400 with BLOCK_EXT_APPLY_BATCH_UNKNOWN_OP and zero events, so operations_count never counts unvalidated operations (the per-op continue at live_server.rs:1771-1776 is gone); the emitted payload of every operation gains the additive fields "request_id" (the client-supplied key or the server-minted "apply_{n}") and "op_index" (its index in the batch), with absent-field serialization preserved for everything else.

The ack channel: a process-global pending-verdict registry (the EXT_DOCUMENT_BINDINGS process-global pattern — the LiveServerState literal in src-tauri/src/main.rs stays untouched) keyed by request_id resolves one verdict per op; start_live_server registers a listener for "mt::ext::text_op_ack" carrying {request_id, op_index, applied, reason} inside the existing SERVER_BOOT block next to the mt::ext::context_response listener (live_server.rs:1949-1969 precedent); the handler awaits verdicts under EXT_APPLY_ACK_TIMEOUT_SECS = 5 applied per batch — one deadline for the whole batch, not per operation — and answers 200 {"applied": true, "operations_count": n} only when every op ack'd applied; a nack answers 409 with the plain error body naming the failed op index and the applied prefix (BLOCK_EXT_APPLY_NOT_APPLIED); a timeout or a missing renderer subscriber answers 504 with a stable reason (BLOCK_EXT_APPLY_ACK_TIMEOUT, the /ext/context 504 precedent at live_server.rs:1674-1677); the 500 emit-failure branch stays as-is.

Bounded idempotency: EXT_APPLY_VERDICTS is a process-global bounded map (EXT_APPLY_DEDUP_CAP = 256 recent entries, evict-oldest, process-local, cleared on restart) keyed by extension id plus request id; when a key is present the handler first consults the recorded verdicts — a terminal replay answers the recorded first verdict (same status, same body) with an additive "duplicate": true marker and re-emits nothing (BLOCK_EXT_APPLY_DUPLICATE) — and a same-key attempt arriving while the first is still pending coalesces onto the pending verdict without a second emit (BLOCK_EXT_APPLY_COALESCED); key registration and the pending slot are created atomically under the dedup mutex BEFORE the first emit, so the same-key race window is closed by construction; when no key was sent the server mints "apply_{n}" for ack correlation only and records no dedup promise; a replay after a restart is not a dedup hit and is answered by the already-recorded-binding fence — documented, not handled.

Module hygiene: dated live_server.rs CHANGE_SUMMARY entry naming the ack channel, the timeout constant and the dedup; every START_BLOCK_/END_BLOCK_ marker paired and unique; the binding fence, capability gate, grant authorization, /stream/* dedup and budget semantics untouched; T-003's apply pins green and the full cargo m045_ext suite green at this task's end except the T-006 invoke/budget pins not yet written.
